Teamcenter that fits the way you work

We customize, integrate, upgrade and support Siemens Teamcenter and Active Workspace. Close to 20 years of PLM experience, based in Nürnberg.

Talk to us See our services

What we do

Four kinds of work, one team that knows Teamcenter from the data model to the user interface.

Customization and implementation

New Teamcenter installations, or changes to the system you already have. We keep customizations separate from the standard, so upgrades stay simple.

  • Data model, workflows and business rules
  • Active Workspace (AWC) user interface and configuration
  • Change, configuration and document management
  • Testing and user training

Integrations

Connect Teamcenter with CAD, ERP, ECAD and your other business systems, so data moves without manual copying.

  • Teamcenter and SAP / ERP
  • CAD and ECAD integrations
  • APIs for legacy systems
  • On-premise, cloud or hybrid setups

Upgrade and data migration

Move to a current Teamcenter release with a clear plan and checked data. Time & material or fixed price.

  • Release upgrades with little downtime
  • Data migration from legacy systems
  • Data integrity checks
  • Support after the upgrade

Support and reporting

Administration, configuration and support for running Teamcenter systems. Reporting with Teamcenter Reporting and Analytics (TcRA).

  • Administration and configuration
  • Health checks and preventive maintenance
  • TcRA reports and dashboards
  • Support packages that fit your team
